name: Enzo Celebration
tagline: Your photo, your stadium celebration in 8 seconds
description: Enzo Celebration is a fan-made AI video maker inspired by a famous hands-behind-the-ears football celebration. Upload one clear photo of yourself, a friend who agreed, or your pet. The AI builds an 8-second vertical 9:16 clip at 720p: the subject walks a fictional stadium touchline, cups both ears, and raises their arms to a generated crowd roar. There's no prompt or editing, and you get an email when it's ready. Packs are one-time from $6.90, with no subscription, and a failed render returns the credit. It isn't affiliated with any player or club, and no real player appears in your clip.
